questions.q: What does VIO give that optical flow does not?
questions.explain: Flow gives velocity; VIO gives a pose; SLAM adds a map.

questions.q: Where does monocular VIO get its scale from?
questions.explain: A mono camera without an IMU does not know the scale.

options: Camera frames that come too often
questions.explain: Lack of texture, bad light, fast rotation, bad calibration and camera–IMU desynchronization: 5 ms means noticeable drift.

questions.q: What should the companion do when VIO loses tracking?
questions.explain: A "frozen" pose is the worst option.

questions.q: How do you test ExternalNav before going to the field?
options: On a bench, moving it by hand
SITL: pose from truth plus noise
questions.explain: Then a source failure and the backup source set.

questions.q: Why does VIO work poorly over a uniform surface (water, snow)?
options: It has no stable points to track
The IMU does not work there
The GPS receiver interferes with the camera over water
questions.explain: Visual odometry needs textured feature points; a uniform surface does not provide them.

questions.q: VIO lost tracking, but the companion keeps sending the same pose with new timestamps. What did ArduCopter 4.7.2 SITL show over 20 s of this failure?
options: `XKF4.SP` rose above 1, the EKF rejected the source and triggered the failsafe
`XKF4.SP` ≤ 0.01, the estimate stays put, the wind carried the vehicle 6–10 m
After 300 ms EKF3 declared the source unhealthy and went to inertial-only
The estimate drifted with the vehicle, and the gap stayed below 0.1 m
questions.explain: The frozen pose matches the "vehicle is stationary" prediction, the innovation is small, the gates stay silent; the autopilot judges source health only by whether messages arrive.

questions.q: The companion sends ArduPilot `ODOMETRY` with `frame_id = MAV_FRAME_LOCAL_NED`. What happens?
options: EKF3 accepts the pose and rotates it into FRD itself
The message is silently dropped: it needs `MAV_FRAME_LOCAL_FRD` and `MAV_FRAME_BODY_FRD`
The autopilot shows a PreArm "ODOMETRY frame" and blocks arming
The pose is accepted and the velocity is ignored
questions.explain: `handle_odometry` in 4.7.2 returns without a message if the frame pair is not LOCAL_FRD / BODY_FRD (`GCS_Common.cpp:4062–4066`); there will be no `VISP` in the log.
